verses.en: Listen to the voice of Jesus Christ, your Redeemer, the Great I Am, whose arm of mercy hath atoned for your sins;
verses.sm: Faalogo mai ia i le siufofoga o Iesu Keriso, lo outou Togiola, le O A’u Silisili, o lona aao alofa mutimutivale ua togiola mo a outou agasala;

verses.en: Who will gather his people even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, even as many as will hearken to my voice and humble themselves before me, and call upon me in mighty prayer.
verses.sm: O lē o le a faapotopotoina ona tagata e pei ona ofaofatai e se matuamoa lana toloai i lalo o ona apaau, le toatele lea o i latou o le a faalogo mai i lo’u leo ma faamaualalalo i latou lava i o’u luma, ma valaau mai ia te a’u i le tatalo faatauanau.

verses.en: Behold, verily, verily, I say unto you, that at this time your sins are forgiven you, therefore ye receive these things; but remember to sin no more, lest perils shall come upon you.
verses.sm: Faauta, e moni, e moni, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ua faamagaloina outou mai ia outou agasala i le taimi nei, o lea ua outou maua ai ia mea; a ia manatua aua le toe agasala, ne’i oo mai tugā i o outou luga.

verses.en: Verily, I say unto you that ye are chosen out of the world to declare my gospel with the sound of rejoicing, as with the voice of a trump.
verses.sm: E moni, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ua filifilia outou mai le lalolagi e alaga atu la’u talalelei ma le leo o olioliga, e pei o le leo o se pu.

verses.en: Lift up your hearts and be glad, for I am in your midst, and am your advocate with the Father; and it is his good will to give you the kingdom.
verses.sm: Ia siitia a’e i luga o outou loto ma fiafia, ona ua Ou i ai i lo outou lotolotoi, ma o A’u o lo outou fautua i le Tamā; ma o lona finagalo agalelei ia tuu atu ia te outou le malo.

verses.en: And, as it is written—Whatsoever ye shall ask in faith, being united in prayer according to my command, ye shall receive.
verses.sm: Ma, e pei ona tusia— Soo se mea tou te ole mai ai i le faatuatua, ma le lotogatasi i le tatalo e tusa ai ma la’u poloaiga, o le a outou maua.

verses.en: And ye are called to bring to pass the gathering of mine elect; for mine elect hear my voice and harden not their hearts;
verses.sm: Ma ua valaaulia outou e faataunuu le faapotopotoina o la’u ’au filifilia; ona o la’u ’au filifilia e faalogo i lo’u leo ma lē faamaaaina o latou loto;

verses.en: Wherefore the decree hath gone forth from the Father that they shall be gathered in unto one place upon the face of this land, to prepare their hearts and be prepared in all things against the day when tribulation and desolation are sent forth upon the wicked.
verses.sm: O le mea lea ua tuuina atu ai le poloaiga mai le Tamā ia faapotopoto mai i latou i le nofoaga e tasi i luga o lenei laueleele, e saunia o latou loto ma saunia ai i mea uma auā le aso pe a oo mai puapuaga ma faatafunaga i luga o e amioleaga.

verses.en: For the hour is nigh and the day soon at hand when the earth is ripe; and all the proud and they that do wickedly shall be as stubble; and I will burn them up, saith the Lord of Hosts, that wickedness shall not be upon the earth;
verses.sm: Ona ua lata mai le itula ma toeitiiti oo mai le aso e matua ai le lalolagi; ma o i latou uma o e faamaualuluga, ma i latou o e ua fai amioleaga, o le a avea faapei o tagutugutu o saito; ma o le a Ou susunuina i latou, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii o ’Au, ina ia lē i ai se amioleaga i le lalolagi;

verses.en: For the hour is nigh, and that which was spoken by mine apostles must be fulfilled; for as they spoke so shall it come to pass;
verses.sm: Ona ua lata mai le itula, ma ua ao ona faataunuuina o mea na fetalaia e a’u aposetolo; auā e pei ona latou fetalai o le a faapea lava ona faataunuuina;

verses.en: For I will reveal myself from heaven with power and great glory, with all the hosts thereof, and dwell in righteousness with men on earth a thousand years, and the wicked shall not stand.
verses.sm: Ona o le a Ou faaali atu a’u lava mai le lagi i le mana ma le mamalu tele faatasi ma ona ’au uma, ma mau faatasi ma tagata i le amiotonu i luga o le lalolagi i le afe o tausaga, ma o le a lē tutu e e amioleaga.

verses.en: And again, verily, verily, I say unto you, and it hath gone forth in a firm decree, by the will of the Father, that mine apostles, the Twelve which were with me in my ministry at Jerusalem, shall stand at my right hand at the day of my coming in a pillar of fire, being clothed with robes of righteousness, with crowns upon their heads, in glory even as I am, to judge the whole house of Israel, even as many as have loved me and kept my commandments, and none else.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni, e moni, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ma ua tuuina atu i se poloaiga tumau, e ala i le finagalo o le Tamā, e faapea o a’u aposetolo, le Toasefululua lea sa faatasi ma a’u i la’u auaunaga i Ierusalema, o le a tutulai i lo’u itu taumatau i le aso ou te alu atu ai i se afi faaniutu, ua faaoofuina i ofu talaloa o le amiotonu, ma palealii i luga o o latou ulu, i le mamalu e pei foi o a’u, e faamasino le aiga atoa o Isaraelu, e tusa ma le toatele o i latou o e na alolofa mai ia te a’u ma tausi i a’u poloaiga, ma e leai lava se isi.

verses.en: For a trump shall sound both long and loud, even as upon Mount Sinai, and all the earth shall quake, and they shall come forth—yea, even the dead which died in me, to receive a crown of righteousness, and to be clothed upon, even as I am, to be with me, that we may be one.
verses.sm: Ona o le a ili umi mai ma leo tele se pu, e pei lava i luga o le Mauga o Sinai, ma o le a lulu le lalolagi atoa, ma o le a latou o mai— ioe, tagata oti lava ia o e na maliliu ia te a’u, e maua se palealii o le amiotonu, ma ia faaoofuina, e pei lava o A’u, e faatasi ma a’u, ina ia tasi i matou.

verses.en: But, behold, I say unto you that before this great day shall come the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall be turned into blood, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and there shall be greater signs in heaven above and in the earth beneath;
verses.sm: Ae, faauta, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ae le’i oo mai lea aso tele o le a faapouliuligia le la, ma o le a liu toto le masina, ma o le a pa’u’ū ifo fetu mai le lagi, ma o le a i ai faailoga tetele i le lagi i lugā ma i le lalolagi i lalō;

verses.en: And there shall be weeping and wailing among the hosts of men;
verses.sm: Ma o le a i ai le tagiaue ma auega i totonu o ’au o tagata;

verses.en: And there shall be a great hailstorm sent forth to destroy the crops of the earth.
verses.sm: Ma o le a i ai se timu uato’a tele e auina mai e faaumatia ai laau totō o le lalolagi.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, because of the wickedness of the world, that I will take vengeance upon the wicked, for they will not repent; for the cup of mine indignation is full; for behold, my blood shall not cleanse them if they hear me not.
verses.sm: Ma o le a oo mai, ona o le amioleaga o le lalolagi, o le a Ou taui atu ai ma sui i luga o e e amioleaga, ona o le a latou lē salamo; ona ua tumu le ipu o lo’u ita; aua faauta, o le a lē faamamaina i latou e lo’u toto pe afai latou te lē faalogo mai ia te a’u.

verses.en: Wherefore, I the Lord God will send forth flies upon the face of the earth, which shall take hold of the inhabitants thereof, and shall eat their flesh, and shall cause maggots to come in upon them;
verses.sm: O le mea lea, o A’u o le Alii le Atua, o le a Ou auina atu lago i luga o le fogaeleele, ia o le a fepiiti i tagata e i ai, ma o le a ’aia o latou tino, ma faia ia oo mai ilo i luga o i latou;

verses.en: And their tongues shall be stayed that they shall not utter against me; and their flesh shall fall from off their bones, and their eyes from their sockets;
verses.sm: Ma o le a taofia o latou laulaufaiva ina ia latou lē faia se upu e faasaga mai ia te a’u; ma o le a pa’u’ū ese o latou aano mai i o latou ponaivi, ma o latou mata mai o latou pogaimata;

verses.en: And it shall come to pass that the beasts of the forest and the fowls of the air shall devour them up.
verses.sm: Ma o le a oo mai o le a ’aina i latou e manu o le vao ma manu felelei o le vanimonimo.

verses.en: And the great and abominable church, which is the whore of all the earth, shall be cast down by devouring fire, according as it is spoken by the mouth of Ezekiel the prophet, who spoke of these things, which have not come to pass but surely must, as I live, for abominations shall not reign.
verses.sm: Ma o le ekalesia tele ma le inosia, le fafine talitane lea o le lalolagi uma, o le a lafo i lalo e le afi faaumatia, e pei ona fetalaia e le fofoga o Esekielu le perofeta, o lē na tautala e uiga i ia mea, ia e lei faataunuuina ae o le a faataunuuina moni lava, e pei ona Ou ola, ona o le a lē manumalo mea inosia.

verses.en: And again, verily, verily, I say unto you that when the thousand years are ended, and men again begin to deny their God, then will I spare the earth but for a little season;
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni, e moni, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, a i’u le afe o tausaga, ma toe amata e tagata ona teena lo latou Atua, ona Ou faasaoina ai lea o le lalolagi ae mo nao se vaitau itiiti;

verses.en: And the end shall come, and the heaven and the earth shall be consumed and pass away, and there shall be a new heaven and a new earth.
verses.sm: Ma o le a oo mai le iuga, ma o le a susunuina ma mavae atu le lagi ma le lalolagi, ma o le a i ai se lagi fou ma se lalolagi fou.

verses.en: For all old things shall pass away, and all things shall become new, even the heaven and the earth, and all the fulness thereof, both men and beasts, the fowls of the air, and the fishes of the sea;
verses.sm: Ona o le a mavae atu mea tuai uma, ma o le a faafouina mea uma, e oo lava i le lagi ma le lalolagi, ma le atoaga o mea uma o i ai, o tagata atoa ma manu vaefa, o manu felelei o le vanimonimo, ma i’a o le sami;

verses.en: And not one hair, neither mote, shall be lost, for it is the workmanship of mine hand.
verses.sm: Ma e leai se lauulu e tasi, po o sina mea itiiti, o le a leiloa, ona o ia mea o le galuega a o’u lima.

verses.en: But, behold, verily I say unto you, before the earth shall pass away, Michael, mine archangel, shall sound his trump, and then shall all the dead awake, for their graves shall be opened, and they shall come forth—yea, even all.
verses.sm: Ae, faauta, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ae lei mavae atu le lalolagi, o le a ili e Mekaeli, la’u agelu sili, lana pu, ona feala mai ai lea o e uma na oti, ona o le a tatalaina o latou tuugamau, ma o le a latou o mai i fafo— ioe, i latou uma lava.

verses.en: And the righteous shall be gathered on my right hand unto eternal life; and the wicked on my left hand will I be ashamed to own before the Father;
verses.sm: Ma o e ua amiotonu o le a faapotopotoina i lo’u lima taumatau mo le ola e faavavau; ma o e ua amioleaga e i lo’u lima tauagavale o le a Ou maasiasi e avea mo o’u i luma o le Tamā;

verses.en: Wherefore I will say unto them—Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels.
verses.sm: O le mea lea o le a Ou fai atu ia te i latou— O ese atu ia mai ia te a’u, outou ua fetuuina, i le afi tumau e faavavau, ua saunia mo le tiapolo ma ana agelu.

verses.en: And now, behold, I say unto you, never at any time have I declared from mine own mouth that they should return, for where I am they cannot come, for they have no power.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, faauta, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, Ou te lei fai atu i soo se taimi mai lo’u lava gutu e faapea o le a latou toe foi mai, ona o le mea Ou te i ai e lē mafai ona latou o mai i ai, ona ua leai se mana ua ia te i latou.

verses.en: But remember that all my judgments are not given unto men; and as the words have gone forth out of my mouth even so shall they be fulfilled, that the first shall be last, and that the last shall be first in all things whatsoever I have created by the word of my power, which is the power of my Spirit.
verses.sm: Ae ia manatua e lē tuuina atu a’u faamasinoga uma i tagata; ma e pei o upu na tuuina atu mai lo’u gutu o le a faapea lava ona faataunuuina i latou, o lē ua muamua o le a mulimuli, ma o lē ua mulimuli o le a muamua i soo se mea o mea uma na Ou foafoaina i le upu a lo’u mana, o le mana lea o lo’u Agaga.

verses.en: For by the power of my Spirit created I them; yea, all things both spiritual and temporal—
verses.sm: Ona o le mana o lo’u Agaga na Ou foafoa ai mea uma; ioe, mea uma faaleagaga atoa ma faaletino—

verses.en: First spiritual, secondly temporal, which is the beginning of my work; and again, first temporal, and secondly spiritual, which is the last of my work—
verses.sm: E muamua le faaleagaga, lona lua le faaletino, o le amataga lea o la’u galuega; o lenei foi, e muamua le faaletino, ma lona lua le faaleagaga, o le mulimuli lea o la’u galuega—

verses.en: Speaking unto you that you may naturally understand; but unto myself my works have no end, neither beginning; but it is given unto you that ye may understand, because ye have asked it of me and are agreed.
verses.sm: I le tautala atu lea ia te outou ina ia outou malamalama e tusa ma o outou natura; ae ia te a’u lava ia, e leai se gataaga o a’u galuega, po o se amataga; ae ua Ou tuuina atu lenei mea ia te outou ina ia outou malamalama, ona ua outou ole mai ai ia te a’u ma ua outou lotogatasi.

verses.en: Wherefore, verily I say unto you that all things unto me are spiritual, and not at any time have I given unto you a law which was temporal; neither any man, nor the children of men; neither Adam, your father, whom I created.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ua faaleagaga mea uma lava ia te a’u, ma Ou te lei tuuina atu lava ia te outou i soo se taimi se tulafono sa faaletino; pe i soo se tagata, po o le fanauga a tagata; pe ia Atamu, lo outou tamā, o lē na Ou foafoaina.

verses.en: Behold, I gave unto him that he should be an agent unto himself; and I gave unto him commandment, but no temporal commandment gave I unto him, for my commandments are spiritual; they are not natural nor temporal, neither carnal nor sensual.
verses.sm: Faauta, sa Ou tuu atu ia te ia ia avea o ia ma pule ia te ia lava; ma sa Ou tuu atu ia te ia poloaiga, peitai e leai se poloaiga faaletino na Ou tuu atu ia te ia, ona o a’u poloaiga ua faaleagaga; ua lē faalenatura i latou pe faalelalolagi, pe faaletino pe faalenautino.

verses.en: And it came to pass that Adam, being tempted of the devil—for, behold, the devil was before Adam, for he rebelled against me, saying, Give me thine honor, which is my power; and also a third part of the hosts of heaven turned he away from me because of their agency;
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua faaosoosoina Atamu, e le tiapolo— aua, faauta, sa i ai le tiapolo muamua atu ia Atamu, ona sa fouvale o ia faasaga mai ia te a’u, fai mai, Tuu mai ia te a’u lou mamalu, o lo’u mana lea; ma sa faaliliu ese foi e ia mai ia te a’u le tasi vae tolu o ’au o le lagi ona o la latou faitalia;

verses.en: And they were thrust down, and thus came the devil and his angels;
verses.sm: Ma sa lafoina i latou i lalo, ma faapea ona i ai o le tiapolo ma ana agelu;

verses.en: And, behold, there is a place prepared for them from the beginning, which place is hell.
verses.sm: Ma, faauta, e i ai se nofoaga ua saunia mo i latou mai le amataga, o lea nofoaga o seoli.

verses.en: And it must needs be that the devil should tempt the children of men, or they could not be agents unto themselves; for if they never should have bitter they could not know the sweet—
verses.sm: Ma e ao ina faaosoosoina e le tiapolo le fanauga a tagata, po o e lē mafai ona avea i latou ma pule ia te i latou lava; auā afai e lē oo lava ia te i latou le oona e lē mafai ona latou iloa le suamalie—

verses.en: Wherefore, it came to pass that the devil tempted Adam, and he partook of the forbidden fruit and transgressed the commandment, wherein he became subject to the will of the devil, because he yielded unto temptation.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, sa oo ina faaosoosoina Atamu e le tiapolo, ma sa ’ai o ia i le fua na faasaina ma soli ai le poloaiga, lea na pulea ai o ia i le loto o le tiapolo, ona ua tuu atu e ia i le faaosoosoga.

verses.en: Wherefore, I, the Lord God, caused that he should be cast out from the Garden of Eden, from my presence, because of his transgression, wherein he became spiritually dead, which is the first death, even that same death which is the last death, which is spiritual, which shall be pronounced upon the wicked when I shall say: Depart, ye cursed.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, o A’u, o le Alii le Atua, na Ou faia ai ia tuli ese o ia i fafo mai le Faatoaga o Etena, mai o’u luma, ona o lana solitulafono, lea na oti ai o ia faaleagaga, o le oti muamua lea, le oti lava lea o le oti mulimuli, le oti faaleagaga lea, lea o le a folafola atu i luga o e amioleaga pe a Ou fai atu: O ese atu ia, outou ua fetuuina.

verses.en: But, behold, I say unto you that I, the Lord God, gave unto Adam and unto his seed, that they should not die as to the temporal death, until I, the Lord God, should send forth angels to declare unto them repentance and redemption, through faith on the name of mine Only Begotten Son.
verses.sm: Ae, faauta, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o A’u, o le Alii le Atua, na Ou tuu atu ia Atamu ma ana fanau, ia latou lē oti i le oti faaletino, seia auina atu e A’u, o le Alii le Atua, agelu e tau atu ia te i latou le salamo ma le togiolaina, e ala i le faatuatua i le suafa o lo’u Atalii Pele e Toatasi.

verses.en: And thus did I, the Lord God, appoint unto man the days of his probation—that by his natural death he might be raised in immortality unto eternal life, even as many as would believe;
verses.sm: Ma sa faapea ona tofia e A’u, o le Alii le Atua, i le tagata, aso o loo nofo vaavaaia ai— ina ia mafai i lona oti faalenatura ona faatuina mai o ia i le ola pea mo le ola e faavavau, le toatele lea o i latou o e e talitonu.

verses.en: And they that believe not unto eternal damnation; for they cannot be redeemed from their spiritual fall, because they repent not;
verses.sm: Ma i le malaia e faavavau, i latou o e e lē talitonu; ona e lē mafai ona togiolaina i latou mai lo latou pa’ū faaleagaga, ona ua latou lē salamo;

verses.en: For they love darkness rather than light, and their deeds are evil, and they receive their wages of whom they list to obey.
verses.sm: Ona ua latou fiafia i le pouliuli nai lo le malamalama, ma ua leaga a latou mea ua fai, ma latou te maua o latou taui mai lē ua latou loto e usiusitai i ai.

verses.en: But behold, I say unto you, that little children are redeemed from the foundation of the world through mine Only Begotten;
verses.sm: Ae faauta, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ua togiolaina tamaiti laiti mai le faavaega o le lalolagi e ala i lo’u Atalii e Toatasi na Fanaua;

verses.en: Wherefore, they cannot sin, for power is not given unto Satan to tempt little children, until they begin to become accountable before me;
verses.sm: O le mea lea, e lē mafai ona agasala i latou, ona ua lē tuuina atu ia Satani le mana e faaosooso ai i tamaiti laiti, sei oo ina amata ona tali mai i latou i o’u luma.

verses.en: For it is given unto them even as I will, according to mine own pleasure, that great things may be required at the hand of their fathers.
verses.sm: Ona e tuu atu ia te i latou e pei lava ona Ou loto i ai, e tusa ma la’u lava filifiliga, ina ia manaomia mai lima o o latou tamā mea sili.

verses.en: And, again, I say unto you, that whoso having knowledge, have I not commanded to repent?
verses.sm: Ma, e faapea foi, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o ai se ua i ai le malamalama, pe Ou te lei poloaiina ea ia salamo?

verses.en: And he that hath no understanding, it remaineth in me to do according as it is written. And now I declare no more unto you at this time. Amen.
verses.sm: Ma o ia o lē ua leai se malamalama o i ai, e tumau pea ia te a’u e faia i ai e pei ona tusia. Ma o lenei Ou te lē toe tau atu ni isi mea ia te outou i le taimi nei. Amene.
